inputs.text: Canada is tightening its immigration and asylum rules specifically against Nigerians and others right after Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, received royal assent on March 26, 2026. This is yet another example of how wealthy nations like Canada are entrenching discriminatory border policies that target vulnerable migrants from the Global South, reinforcing historical inequalities and structural racism instead of addressing the root causes of displacement or protecting the rights of those most in need. These moves prioritize exclusion over any real commitment to social justice or equity for marginalized communities.
